My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I recently completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT (May 2026) and came across several embedded software openings at TP-Link that align with my background in embedded C/C++, edge AI deployment, and system-level software.

Before applying, I wanted to ask directly - I noticed one posting specifies continuous work authorization without visa sponsorship. I am currently on F-1 OPT, which provides valid US work authorization without employer action required. I found three roles on TP-Link's Workable page (IDs: 0DC81C1556, E78A84552E, F943A617EC) and wanted to confirm whether OPT is compatible with those specific openings before investing time in an application.

If you are able to clarify, or point me to the right contact, I would greatly appreciate it. Happy to share my resume if my background seems like a fit.
draft.sign_off:
Thank you,
Justin Mascarenhas
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/justinmascarenhas
